questions.question: Do you have the Lumen desk lamp in? I need two of them by Thursday and I would rather not order and then be told.
Is the Harbour wool throw available in the oatmeal colour, and how many have you got? It is a present so I need it this week.
Your assistant has told me twice this week that the Tidewater mug set is sold out. I was in the Kreuzberg shop on Saturday and there was a stack of them on the table by the door. Which is it?
Any chance the Alder side table is back in? I have been checking for a fortnight.
How many of the Field canvas totes do you have left? I am buying for a team of nine and I do not want to split the order.

I have been trying to buy the Sona floor rug since Friday and every time I ask, the chat says it is gone. Has it actually gone, or is something wrong with your website? I will buy it today if you have one.
Is the copper stovetop kettle in stock, and is it the two-litre one? Happy to collect.
Do you have the Ridge linen duvet in king size? I ordered one last month, it arrived damaged, and I would like to reorder rather than wait for a replacement.
